extra_vocab.en: a storm with thunder, lightning, and heavy rain
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於天氣預報、航班延誤與活動取消的情境，指伴隨打雷閃電的大雨。常和 severe、warning、delay 一起出現。

example.en: Afternoon thunderstorms are common in this area during summer.
example.zh: 這個地區夏天午後常有雷雨。

example.en: A severe thunderstorm is expected to hit the city tonight.
example.zh: 預計今晚會有強烈雷雨襲擊這座城市。

example.en: The weather office issued a thunderstorm warning for the coast.
example.zh: 氣象局針對沿海地區發布了雷雨警報。

example.en: We were caught in a thunderstorm on the way to work.
example.zh: 我們在上班途中遇上了雷雨。

examples.en: The flight was delayed for two hours because of a thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 班機因為雷雨延誤了兩個小時。

examples.en: The outdoor concert was canceled due to a sudden thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 戶外演唱會因為突然的雷雨而取消。

examples.en: A thunderstorm made it hard to drive to the client's office.
examples.zh: 一場雷雨讓開車去客戶的辦公室變得很困難。

confusable.diff: thunder 只是「雷聲」；thunderstorm 是整場有雷聲、閃電和大雨的暴風雨。

example.en: The loud thunder woke everyone in the hotel last night.
example.zh: 昨晚的大雷聲把飯店裡的人都吵醒了。

example.en: Lightning hit a power line near our factory yesterday.
example.zh: 昨天閃電擊中了我們工廠附近的電線。

example.en: The forecast says rain will continue until Friday.
example.zh: 預報說雨會一直下到星期五。

derived.link: thunderstorm = thunder（雷聲）+ storm（暴風雨），打雷的暴風雨

extra_vocab.en: the act of sending a signal, data, or a disease from one place to another
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於資訊科技、廣播與汽車維修情境：資料或訊號的傳送，也指汽車的變速箱。是 transmit 的名詞。

example.en: The system records all transmissions between the two offices.
example.zh: 系統會記錄兩個辦公室之間所有的傳輸。

example.en: Data transmission was slow because of the network problem.
example.zh: 因為網路問題，資料傳輸很慢。

example.en: Most rental cars here have an automatic transmission.
example.zh: 這裡大部分的租賃車都是自排。

example.en: The transmission of the signal was cut off by the storm.
example.zh: 訊號的傳送被暴風雨中斷了。

examples.en: Please check the transmission speed of the new network.
examples.zh: 請檢查新網路的傳輸速度。

examples.en: We need to repair the transmission before the trip.
examples.zh: 出發旅行前，我們需要先修理變速箱。

examples.en: Washing hands helps stop the transmission of germs.
examples.zh: 洗手有助於阻止細菌傳播。

examples.en: The live transmission of the speech started at noon.
examples.zh: 演講的實況轉播從中午開始。

confusable.diff: transition 是「轉變、過渡」；transmission 是「傳送」。拼法相近，意思不同。

example.en: The transition to the new system will take a month.
example.zh: 轉換到新系統需要一個月的時間。

similar.diff: transfer 指把錢、人或東西從一處移到另一處；transmission 偏重訊號、資料的傳送。

example.en: A bank transfer takes about two business days.
example.zh: 銀行轉帳大約需要兩個工作天。

example.en: The phone signal is weak inside this old building.
example.zh: 這棟老建築裡的手機訊號很弱。

example.en: The network was down for an hour this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上網路中斷了一個小時。

derived.link: transmit 去掉動詞字尾變成 -ion，把「傳送」這個動作變成名詞，像 permit → permission
transmit + -er，做傳送工作的東西，像 printer、computer

senses.en: the sending of data or a signal from one place to another

example.en: The transmission of the video file took ten minutes.
example.zh: 傳送這個影片檔花了十分鐘。

senses.en: the part of a car that sends power from the engine to the wheels
senses.distinguish: 句中出現 car、engine、repair、garage 時，指的是汽車的變速箱。

example.en: The garage found a problem with the van's transmission.
example.zh: 修車廠發現這輛廂型車的變速箱有問題。

senses.en: the spread of a disease from one person to another
senses.distinguish: 句中出現 disease、germs、health 時，指的是疾病的傳染。

example.en: Masks can reduce the transmission of the flu in offices.
example.zh: 口罩可以降低辦公室裡流感的傳播。

extra_vocab.en: to send a signal, data, or a message to another place or person
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於資訊科技、通訊與公共衛生情境：傳送資料、訊號、檔案，也可指疾病傳染。語氣比 send 更技術、更正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: transmit 的過去式和 -ing 要重複 t：transmitted、transmitting。

example.en: This device transmits data to the main server every hour.
example.zh: 這個裝置每小時會把資料傳送到主伺服器。

example.en: The report was transmitted to the client without any errors.
example.zh: 這份報告已經順利傳送給客戶，沒有任何錯誤。

example.en: The company is transmitting the results to its clients now.
example.zh: 公司現在正在把結果傳送給客戶。

example.en: The sensor can transmit data without a cable.
example.zh: 這個感測器不用接線也能傳送資料。

example.en: The tower transmits a signal across the whole city.
example.zh: 這座塔把訊號發送到整座城市。

example.en: Please transmit the information to all branch offices.
example.zh: 請把這項資訊傳達給所有分公司。

examples.en: Please transmit the signed form to our legal team today.
examples.zh: 請今天把簽好的表格傳送給我們的法務團隊。

examples.en: Washing your hands can stop germs from being transmitted.
examples.zh: 洗手可以防止細菌被傳染。

examples.en: The meeting will be transmitted live to all branches.
examples.zh: 這場會議將即時轉播給所有分公司。

confusable.diff: transfer 是把人、錢或東西轉移到另一處；transmit 是傳送訊號、資料或病菌。

example.en: She will transfer to our Tokyo office next month.
example.zh: 她下個月會調到我們的東京辦公室。

similar.diff: send 日常通用；transmit 較技術、較正式，常用於資料、訊號與疾病。

example.en: Please send the file to me before noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把檔案寄給我。

similar.diff: pass on 較口語，常指把消息或疾病轉告、傳給別人。

example.en: Please pass on this message to the sales team.
example.zh: 請把這則訊息轉告給業務團隊。

example.en: We lost the signal when the train entered the tunnel.
example.zh: 火車進入隧道時，我們失去了訊號。

derived.link: transmit 變成 -ion，把「傳送」這個動作變成名詞，像 permit → permission
transmit + -er，做傳送工作的東西，像 printer、computer

senses.en: to send data or a signal from one place to another

example.en: The system will transmit the files to the cloud tonight.
example.zh: 系統今晚會把檔案傳送到雲端。

senses.en: to pass a disease from one person to another
senses.distinguish: 句中出現 disease、virus、germs 時，指的是疾病的傳染。

example.en: Some viruses can be transmitted through shared office equipment.
example.zh: 有些病毒可以透過共用的辦公設備傳染。

extra_vocab.en: having a good flavor that you enjoy
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳、飯店、活動餐點與食品廣告，意思是「好吃」。比 delicious 日常、輕鬆。

example.en: Our new recipe is tastier than the old one.
example.zh: 我們的新食譜比舊的更好吃。

example.en: This is the tastiest dish on the lunch menu.
example.zh: 這是午餐菜單上最好吃的一道菜。

example.en: Employees can enjoy a tasty snack in the break room.
example.zh: 員工可以在休息室享用美味的點心。

example.en: The chef created a tasty dish with local vegetables.
example.zh: 主廚用當地蔬菜做了一道美味的菜。

example.en: The cakes in the window look very tasty.
example.zh: 櫥窗裡的蛋糕看起來很好吃。

examples.en: The soup was warm and tasty, so we ordered another.
examples.zh: 這碗湯又熱又好喝，所以我們又點了一碗。

examples.en: The caterer prepared a tasty lunch for all guests.
examples.zh: 外燴業者為所有賓客準備了美味的午餐。

examples.en: Our healthy snacks are tasty and easy to carry.
examples.zh: 我們的健康點心既好吃又方便攜帶。

confusable.diff: tasteful 是「有品味的」，形容設計、裝飾等；tasty 才是「好吃的」。

example.en: The office has tasteful furniture and soft colors.
example.zh: 這間辦公室的家具很有品味，色彩也很柔和。

similar.diff: delicious 語氣更強、更正式，常用於菜單或評論；tasty 較日常。

example.en: The dessert at the banquet was absolutely delicious.
example.zh: 宴會上的甜點真是太美味了。

example.en: The new ice cream comes in three different flavors.
example.zh: 這款新冰淇淋有三種不同的口味。

example.en: We only use fresh fruit in our desserts.
example.zh: 我們的甜點只用新鮮水果。

derived.link: tasty = taste + -y，有好味道的，像 salty、sunny

extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於正面的評價與感謝，例如 terrific job、terrific idea、terrific news。語氣熱情、口語，用來誇獎人或事情。

example.en: You did a terrific job on the presentation today.
example.zh: 你今天的簡報做得非常棒。

example.en: That is a terrific idea for the new campaign.
example.zh: 這對新的宣傳活動來說是個很棒的點子。

example.en: We just received terrific news about the new contract.
example.zh: 我們剛收到關於新合約的好消息。

example.en: The hotel staff gave us terrific service all week.
example.zh: 飯店員工整個星期都給我們極好的服務。

examples.en: The sales results for this quarter are terrific.
examples.zh: 這一季的銷售成績非常棒。

examples.en: Thank you for your terrific support during the project.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在專案期間給予的極佳支持。

examples.en: The restaurant has a terrific view of the harbor.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳有極佳的港口景色。

confusable.diff: terrific 是正面的「很棒」，terrible 是負面的「很糟」，意思幾乎相反。

example.en: The weather was terrible, so the outdoor event was canceled.
example.zh: 天氣很糟，所以戶外活動取消了。

similar.diff: wonderful 語氣溫暖、通用；terrific 更口語、更熱情。

example.en: It was wonderful to meet you at the conference.
example.zh: 很高興在研討會上認識你。

similar.diff: excellent 較正式，常用於書面評價；terrific 較口語。

example.en: Her excellent report impressed the whole board of directors.
example.zh: 她出色的報告讓整個董事會印象深刻。

extra_vocab.en: a cloth that covers a table, especially at meals
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳、飯店與宴會佈置情境，指鋪在餐桌上的桌巾。是 table + cloth 組成的複合名詞。

example.en: The hotel washes its tablecloths every morning.
example.zh: 飯店每天早上都會清洗桌巾。

example.en: Please spread a clean tablecloth over each table.
example.zh: 請在每張桌子上鋪一條乾淨的桌巾。

collocations.zh: 白色桌巾（常指高級餐廳）

example.en: The restaurant is known for its white tablecloth service.
example.zh: 這家餐廳以白色桌巾的高級服務聞名。

example.en: Staff must change the tablecloth after every customer.
example.zh: 員工必須在每位客人用完餐後更換桌巾。

examples.en: A waiter put a tablecloth on the table before dinner.
examples.zh: 服務生在晚餐前在桌上鋪了一條桌巾。

examples.en: The tablecloth matched the color of the flowers perfectly.
examples.zh: 桌巾和花的顏色非常搭。

examples.en: Please order a red tablecloth for the new dining room.
examples.zh: 請為新的用餐室訂購一條紅色桌巾。

examples.en: There is a coffee stain on the tablecloth.
examples.zh: 桌巾上有一塊咖啡漬。

confusable.diff: tablet 是「平板電腦」或「藥片」，拼法相近，和桌巾無關。

example.en: Guests can order food from a tablet on the table.
example.zh: 客人可以用桌上的平板電腦點餐。

example.en: Please put a napkin next to each plate.
example.zh: 請在每個盤子旁邊放一張餐巾。

example.en: The menu changes every week at this restaurant.
example.zh: 這家餐廳的菜單每週都會更換。

extra_vocab.en: wanting or needing to drink something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐飲、活動與旅遊情境，描述人想喝水或飲料。常用 feel thirsty、get thirsty。

example.en: After the long walk, I felt thirstier than before.
example.zh: 走了很長一段路後，我比之前更渴了。

example.en: The thirstiest runners rushed to the water table after the race.
example.zh: 比賽結束後，最口渴的跑者衝向供水站。

example.en: I always feel thirsty after a long meeting.
example.zh: 開完長時間的會議後，我總是覺得口渴。

example.en: Guests get thirsty quickly in the hot hall.
example.zh: 客人在悶熱的大廳裡很快就會口渴。

example.en: Moving boxes in the warehouse all day is thirsty work.
example.zh: 整天在倉庫搬箱子是會讓人口渴的工作。

examples.en: Please offer cold water to guests who look thirsty.
examples.zh: 請為看起來口渴的賓客提供冰水。

examples.en: Our drink machine is perfect for thirsty office workers.
examples.zh: 我們的飲料機很適合口渴的上班族。

examples.en: The tour guide brought extra bottles for thirsty visitors.
examples.zh: 導遊多帶了幾瓶水給口渴的遊客。

confusable.diff: thirty 是數字「三十」，/ˈθɝːti/，發音和拼法都和 thirsty 很像，少了 s。

example.en: The meeting room can hold thirty people at most.
example.zh: 這間會議室最多可容納三十人。

example.en: Many hungry customers lined up outside the cafe.
example.zh: 許多餓了的顧客在咖啡館外排隊。

example.en: Free beverages are served at the front desk.
example.zh: 櫃檯提供免費飲料。

derived.link: thirsty = thirst + -y，有口渴感覺的，像 rainy、sunny

extra_vocab.en: a strong feeling of excitement and happiness
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於旅遊、活動與銷售情境。名詞指令人興奮的感覺，動詞指讓人非常興奮；常以 be thrilled to + V 表示「很開心地…」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 感到興奮的人用 thrilled，帶來刺激的事物用 thrilling；be thrilled to 後面接原形動詞。

example.en: The amusement park promises many thrills for young visitors.
example.zh: 這座遊樂園承諾為年輕遊客帶來許多刺激。

example.en: Her speech thrills the audience at every company event.
example.zh: 她的演講每次在公司活動上都讓觀眾很興奮。

example.en: The news thrilled everyone on the sales team.
example.zh: 這個消息讓業務團隊的每個人都很興奮。

example.en: The customers were thrilled with the fast service.
example.zh: 顧客對快速的服務感到非常滿意。

example.en: The new ride is thrilling visitors from all over Asia.
example.zh: 這個新設施讓來自亞洲各地的遊客非常興奮。

example.en: She felt the thrill of closing her first big deal.
example.zh: 她感受到談成第一筆大生意的興奮。

example.en: I am thrilled to join your team next month.
example.zh: 我很開心下個月能加入你們的團隊。

example.en: The thrill ride is the park's most popular attraction.
example.zh: 這個刺激的遊樂設施是園區最受歡迎的景點。

examples.en: The thrill of winning a big client keeps him motivated.
examples.zh: 贏得大客戶的興奮感讓他保持幹勁。

examples.en: Visitors come to the park for the thrill and the views.
examples.zh: 遊客來到這個園區是為了刺激和風景。

examples.en: Skiing offers a thrill that many tourists cannot find elsewhere.
examples.zh: 滑雪帶來許多遊客在別處找不到的刺激。

similar.diff: excitement 較一般、範圍廣；thrill 帶有刺激、緊張的快感。

example.en: The excitement in the room grew before the announcement.
example.zh: 宣布之前，房間裡的興奮氣氛越來越濃。

similar.diff: delight 強調開心、愉快；thrill 強調刺激與興奮。

example.en: The staff read the good news with great delight.
example.zh: 員工帶著極大的喜悅讀著這則好消息。

derived.link: thrill + -er，讓人興奮緊張的東西，像 teacher、player

example.en: Winning the award gave her a big thrill.
example.zh: 獲獎讓她感到非常興奮。

example.en: The sudden good news will thrill our loyal customers.
example.zh: 這個突如其來的好消息會讓我們的忠實顧客很興奮。
